name: Brass Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a haunted dark trumpet whose silver valve caps are its eyes, with pink keys and orange plasma notes
entry: Its fanfare is loud enough to rattle windows. It marches through towns at dawn, waking everyone up.
how: Use a Phantom Mouthpiece on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Flash Cannon in this form.
